findings.problem: Round 2 E2E failure (meta-darkness 'Darkness 3/10' instead of 9 after reopening run 1 from /futures/<run2>) was fixed by making RunView subscribe to route.paramMap and FutureResultComponent reload on runId changes (run-view.ts, future-result.ts). No unit test covers navigating between two /futures/:runId URLs inside the same RunView instance, so only the 60 s E2E guards the regression. Missing exhaustive test for route-param change in RunView: /futures/A -> /futures/B must issue getRun(B), then getFutureResult(B) (no further getFutureResult(A)), render B's headline/meta, and load B's configuration into ScenarioStore. The case /futures/A -> /futures/A (same id, e.g. after start()) must issue no second getRun and must not touch the panel.
